LAREDO — A Laredo man was booked into the Webb County Jail early Saturday morning on a third-degree felony family-violence charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Gilberto Pena III was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 12:21 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record lists the charge as assault of a family or household member by impeding breath or circulation — a third-degree felony under Texas law — and bond was set at $30,000.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Gilberto Pena III arrested on third-degree felony family-violence charge
